remaining_limits: Not integrated into any production core/top, HUD, LED or native engine; parent must wire a new candidate and document source-vector bit mapping.
No full60/PDS/board run. Synthesizable Verilog structure and ModelSim compilation are not physical implementation or CDC signoff.
UI inputs must be UI-owned/synchronously sampled; unclocked sub-UI pulses require a defined upstream capture circuit.
Stage/DQS context tied to zero means unconnected if recorded as such in the integration manifest; do not interpret as measured PHY state.
Later transient source levels can coalesce; this is current-plus-first-event diagnostics, not a complete event FIFO.
Any multi-bit display/export needs another coherent snapshot transfer. Do not reintroduce per-bit bus tearing.
The observer does not infer RAW motion, marker quality or causality of HELD video. Those measurements remain independent.
